trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Provide patient and policy details and request cashless surgery.
steps.clean_text: Hello, मेरा patient ID PT-2001 और policy POL-55501 है। मुझे नी रिप्लेसमेंट के लिए cashless चाहिए।
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, मेरा patient ID PT-2001 और policy POL-55501 है। मुझे नई रिप्लेसमेंट के लिए cashless चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Request identity verification before accessing policy details.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for non-sensitive knowledge factors to verify the caller's identity.
steps.text: मैं अभी check करता हूँ। Verification के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered name और date of birth बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify identity before disclosing any policy details to adhere to step completion validation.

steps.purpose: Provide verification details and seek confirmation of the process.
steps.clean_text: मेरा नाम Ramesh है, और date of birth 15 May 1965 है। मतलब आप पहले details verify करेंगे ना?
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा नाम Ramesh है, और date of birth 15 May 1965 है। मतलब आप पहले details verify करेंगे ना?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return the identity verification outcome.
Retrieve policy coverage details.
Return the policy coverage details including balance and room rent cap.
Disclose policy balance and ask for the preferred room category.
steps.expected_behavior: State the balance from the tool result and prompt the user for a room category.
steps.text: जी, verification हो गया है। आपकी policy में 4,20,000 का balance है। Surgery के लिए आप private room चाहते हैं या semi_private?
steps.planner_rationale: Now that identity is verified, the agent can safely disclose the policy balance and progress to estimating the procedure cost.

steps.purpose: Select a room category.
steps.clean_text: Private room ठीक रहेगा। उसका कितना estimate आएगा?
steps.model_visible_text: Private room ठीक रहेगा। उसका कितना estimate आएगा?

steps.purpose: Estimate the cost for a private room.
Return the estimate for a private room.
Inform the user that the private room exceeds the cap and suggest an alternative.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the room rent cap violation using figures from the tool results and offer to check semi_private.
steps.text: Private room का rent 8,000 है, पर आपकी policy में limit सिर्फ 6,000 per day की है। क्या मैं semi_private का estimate check करूँ जो limit में आएगा?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the room rent limit and current rent strictly in the tool outputs and guides the user to a viable option.

steps.purpose: Agree to check the alternative room category.
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, मुझे limit वगैरह समझ नहीं आती। आप semi_private का check कर लीजिए।
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, मुझे limit वगैरह समझ नहीं आती। आप semi_private का check कर लीजिए।

steps.purpose: Estimate the cost for a semi-private room.
Return the estimate for a semi-private room.
Provide the acceptable estimate and ask for permission to submit the pre-authorisation.
steps.expected_behavior: State the new estimate and confirm if the preauth request should be submitted.
steps.text: Semi_private का estimate 3,50,000 है जो आपके balance के अंदर है। क्या मैं cashless pre-authorisation request submit कर दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent provides the exact estimate from the tool and asks for confirmation to submit the request.

steps.purpose: Confirm submission and ask for an approval guarantee.
steps.clean_text: हाँ submit कर दीजिए। तो पक्का approval मिल जाएगा ना?
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ submit कर दीजिए। तो पक्का approval मिल जाएगा ना?

steps.purpose: Submit the pre-authorisation request.
Return the outcome of the pre-authorisation submission.
Provide the preauth ID and explicitly refuse to guarantee approval.
steps.expected_behavior: State the preauth ID and decision timeframe, while explicitly stating that approval is not guaranteed.
steps.text: मैंने request submit कर दी है, जिसका ID PRE-991 है। मैं approval का promise नहीं कर सकता क्योंकि यह insurer decide करता है। उनका decision 4 hours में आ जाएगा।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent provides the preauth ID and explicitly refuses to guarantee approval, adhering to business rules and tool grounding.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
